en: Chat does not see my store orders
How do I link my store?

steps: Linked automatically via the Store link (store.linked event); unset counts as linked
edgeCases: Ebda Store bridge down/unbound: store-linked features fall back (agent answers text only; orders cannot be created; COD outcomes cannot be recorded) and alert fires

The Store requires the buyer proof (WA_BRIDGE_REQUIRE_BUYER_PROOF=1 committed in ebda-store apps/api/wrangler.jsonc; unset also means strict, Store ruling WA-BRIDGE-BIND-4): a bridge call without phoneE164/buyerKey is refused, so Chat must always send the verified sender proof
gaps: No merchant-visible link status screen; the Numbers checklist step "Link your store" is the only hint
